items.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
items.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. They can use visual plans--points, bounding boxes, and trajectories--to represent spatial goals and anticipate motion. However, autoregressive vision-language models generate these plans one coordinate token at a time, making richer predictions increasingly costly. We introduce VFlash, a method for fast, accurate visual planning through Flash Primitive Decoding. VFlash exploits the known structure of visual primitives to predict their coordinates jointly, using a lightweight drafter that

items.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
items.summary: SLA is a spatial-language-action model that continually pre-trains and post-trains a pretrained VLA policy with spatial alignment to a frozen 3D perception model, using feature-dependent gates and probabilistic state dropout to improve spatial understanding across diverse robot data while preserving inference architecture.

items.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
items.summary: A selective harness-rescue training method uses specialized sibling harnesses to replace failed reinforcement learning rollouts and transfer their benefits into a single policy that performs better under the original base harness.

items.title: Random Is Almost Enough? Stable and Low-Cost Benchmark Compression via BestRand
items.summary: Benchmark compression reduces the often prohibitive time and cost of model evaluation by evaluating models on a small benchmark subset that closely matches full-benchmark results. To quantify estimation error, we derive an accurate analytical approximation to the error distribution when estimating full-benchmark scores from a subset, showing that most subsets yield small errors, while a few produce much larger errors, resulting in a long-tailed distribution. This means random sampling alone can achieve surprisingly strong performance with high probability, but remains unstable due to rare larg

items.title: From Autonomous Agents to Cognitive Symbionts: Toward AI-Augmented Human Intelligence
items.summary: Physical AI should include AI-augmented human intelligence via lifelong cognitive symbionts that close cognitive gaps through sensing, context retention, and proactive assistance, requiring embedded governance.

items.title: WeLM-Image: A Unified Image Generation Model towards Visual Intelligence
items.summary: We present WeLM-Image, a unified image foundation model that integrates multimodal understanding into text-to-image generation, instruction-guided editing, and multi-reference synthesis. Designed for single-GPU deployment in WeChat's large-scale consumer applications, the model processes text, reference images, and target latents as one interleaved sequence. A Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) backbone combines shared attention with independent understanding and generation parameters to limit optimization interference. Equipping each path with Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) modules provides sparse capac

items.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
items.summary: TailSteer, a final-stage training framework, reduces cumulative visual drift in multi-turn editing by keeping early denoising dynamics close to the base model and learning tail-focused preservation corrections from on-policy rollouts, preserving pretrained generative and editing abilities.

items.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
items.summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. In this paper, we introduce EvoMemState, a state-centric framework that augments persistent facts

items.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.summary: NEO-VLA eliminates fixed visual encoders to let action policies access evolving visual representations across network depths, improving manipulation robustness.

items.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
items.summary: FrontierPhysics is an end-to-end benchmark of 56 expert-designed physics tasks that evaluates AI agents on literature review, research planning, experimentation, and manuscript production using deterministic verifiers and expert rubrics.

items.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
items.summary: TurnWise improves streaming video understanding by assigning turn-level credit and balancing decision weights in group relative policy optimization.

items.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.summary: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T via Pass@(K,T), we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. items.title: GameVerse: A Minute-Scale Gameplay Dataset for Long-Horizon Interactive World Modeling
items.summary: GameVerse is a large-scale gameplay dataset with minute-long sequences and event-aligned annotations that improves long-horizon interactive world modeling.

items.title: Halley: A Predictive Control Plane for Optical AI Data Center Networks
items.summary: Halley is a predictive control framework for AI data center optical networks that improves effective throughput and reduces capacity needs by forecasting failures and controlling resources with formal guarantees.

items.title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
items.summary: VideoMemBench evaluates multimodal language models on long multi-turn video dialogues requiring retrieval of earlier visual and conversational context, revealing substantial performance gaps.

items.title: EmoReward: Self-Evolving Reward Calibration for Emotional Video Generation RL
items.summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. items.title: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
items.summary: Route Anything is a framework for dynamically selecting and coordinating specialized AI models and policies across diverse tasks to improve performance and efficiency.

items.title: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
items.summary: Pandora is a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models evolving psychological and relational states to generate more authentic, individually aligned expressions and reduce AI-like responses.

items.title: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
items.summary: MoviEdit is an end-to-end framework for long-form multi-shot video editing that uses cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive modeling and a new benchmark to maintain coherence across scenes while reducing manual data annotation.

items.title: Behind Video Generation: Observations and Insights on Multimodal Understanding from Kling
items.summary: Kling's multimodal understanding stack links caption density, perceptual text encoding, reward modeling, and evaluation protocols to improve controllable video generation.

items.title: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.summary: LoCo uses local preference learning to teach reasoning models when to stop deliberating, reducing output length substantially while preserving or improving accuracy across math and code tasks.

items.title: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
items.summary: DreamX leverages a pretrained video diffusion model to learn compact, appearance-invariant latent actions that enable cross-embodiment transfer and efficient policy learning.

items.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
items.summary: RoboColosseum evaluates general robot policies across diverse embodiments and environments, revealing weak cross-embodiment agreement, limited open-world reliability, and substantial differences between zero-shot and fine-tuned performance.

items.title: Factorized MLLM Embeddings for Composed Image Retrieval
items.summary: FactEmbed improves composed image retrieval by decoupling query understanding from embedding construction through factorized latents that simulate visual modifications before retrieval.

items.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
items.summary: This report proposes a unified taxonomy and literature system for agentic computer graphics driven by large language models, analyzing trends and open challenges in human-agent collaboration and long-horizon planning.

items.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
items.summary: Wave Forcing enables efficient continuous long-video generation with consistent appearance and natural motion through co-designed generation, training, and execution, achieving high throughput and quality.

items.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
items.summary: CoworkOS is a long-horizon agent harness that separates strategy from execution, supports human-in-the-loop collaboration via shared artifacts, and improves model performance through sustained automated post-training.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: Agent harnesses integrate video generation and world models to enable planning, tool use, and recursive self-improvement for autonomous multi-shot video production.

items.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
items.summary: Uni-robot-agent enables open-weight robot-use agents to surpass proprietary models in zero-shot manipulation and suggests joint development of four core capabilities for future training.

items.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
items.summary: CUA-Master uses nested recursive loops with open-world data and feedback-driven retries to continuously improve computer-use agents across diverse benchmarks.

items.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
items.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.

items.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
items.summary: SWE-Trail improves trajectory collection for coding agents by using past rollouts to guide exploration without exposing history to the agent, yielding better-trained student models.

items.title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
items.summary: Co-designing a resource-heavy reasoning system with a lightweight predictive evaluator can reduce execution costs by filtering interactions, with efficiency governed by the density of useful interactions.

items.title: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary: R²Orch uses recursive self-play with learnable task selection and skill withdrawal to train orchestrators without hand-designed curricula, improving performance across reasoning and interactive tasks.

items.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: LARC enables continuous latent reasoning for unified multimodal models, improving image generation quality and enabling test-time scaling without discrete token bottlenecks.

items.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: Apriel Voice 27B Preview is an open speech-language model that integrates speech understanding, reasoning, and tool use within a shared backbone, achieving strong results on audio benchmarks through a two-stage training procedure with online distillation.

items.title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
items.summary: FrameForge enables adaptive conditional image generation by modeling variable condition-target relationships through dynamic temporal experts and intermediate reasoning pathways in pretrained video models.

items.title: Follow the Gradient: Tracing Safety Degradation Back to Training Data
items.summary: SimpleLoRIF uses gradient alignment to filter instruction data that silently degrades LLM safety, yielding a safer dataset that reduces adversarial success while preserving capabilities.

items.title: ReLift: Dense 3D Tracking as Lifted Trajectory Repair
items.summary: ReLift improves dense 3D tracking by repairing and completing lifted trajectories using geometric trajectory refinement without requiring image-based training.

items.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: CEPO improves multi-agent prompt optimization by separating shared coordination from agent-specific execution, boosting performance across benchmarks and scaling efficiently with more agents.
